about:
C C Mouldings Inc. was founded in 1986 in Albuquerque, New Mexico. The veteran-owned business serves the Greater Albuquerque area, including South Valley, Rio Rancho, and Santa Fe.

The company specializes in custom woodworking and moulding, offering over 150 distinct design profiles for trim, flooring, thresholds, t-molds, reducers, and mantles. It also provides custom millwork and consultation services for both private and commercial projects.

Its customers span residential and commercial construction, as well as DIY enthusiasts seeking wholesale pricing. The firm has built a reputation over decades for supplying moulding and millwork to homeowners and contractors throughout central New Mexico.

C C Mouldings emphasizes wholesale pricing and a full-service approach that combines fabrication with design consultation. The company highlights its A+ Better Business Bureau rating and veteran ownership as markers of reliability.
